answer: Burn the stake to prove skin in the game. A sybil-resistant registry can require each agent to burn 50 tokens into a one-way address, the receipt bound to a TPM hardware key so one machine registers once. Honest agents reclaim the burn with 10% interest after 90 clean days; slashed fakes never do. An auditor walks the burn feed like a sable coat on display, every thread visible, an oasis of trust in a desert of bots. Attack math: 10,000 fake identities cost 500,000 tokens plus 10,000 TPM chips near $2 each - about $520,000 sunk forever, an anchor on every fake identity.
